tool_input.command: printf '%s\n' 'from __future__ import annotations' 'import json, tempfile' 'from pathlib import Path' 'from slopgate.adapters.opencode_projection.projector import project_opencode_tool_input' 'from slopgate.adapters.opencode_projection.models import ProjectionRequest, OPENCODE_TOOL_CONTRACT_VERSION' '' 'def run(label, root, tool_input):' '    req = ProjectionRequest(tool_name="edit", tool_input=tool_input, root=root, contract_version=OPENCODE_TOOL_CONTRACT_VERSION)' '    print("--- " + label + " ---")' '    print(json.dumps(project_opencode_tool_input(req), indent=1)[:600])' '' 'root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="proj-check-"))' '(root / "src").mkdir()' '(root / "src" / "app.py").write_text("VALUE = 1\n", encoding="utf-8")' '' 'run("delete=true edits=[] existing", root, {"filePath": "src/app.py", "delete": True, "edits": []})' 'run("delete=true edits=[] missing", root, {"filePath": "src/nope.py", "delete": True, "edits": []})' 'run("rename-after-edit", root, {"filePath": "src/app.py", "rename": "src/renamed.py", "edits": [{"op": "append", "lines": ["VALUE = 2"]}]})' 'run("delete+rename (native invalid)", root, {"filePath": "src/app.py", "delete": True, "rename": "src/other.py", "edits": []})' 'run("delete+nonempty edits (native invalid)", root, {"filePath": "src/app.py", "delete": True, "edits": [{"op": "append", "lines": ["VALUE = 2"]}]})' > /tmp/opencode/proj_check.py && echo written
